_about: Every database function that rewrites a jsonb column, and what kind of write it is. scripts/check-saves.mjs reads this. event: one write per thing the player did, so an unchanged rewrite cannot repeat. save: called again and again, so it must skip an unchanged write (is distinct from). An unguarded save stays here with status open and an owner until it is fixed. The rule: knowledge base, platform/platform-database-saves.md.

ps_save_put.note: The shared cloud save (assets/cloudsave.js): College Commish, NFL Dynasty, the Trade Machine, Full Team and the two coaching games' playbooks. Since 174 it returns before the write when the payload and progress are unchanged, and answers without the payload (site PR 1030).

rtd_career_merge.note: Kept for cached pages. Since 172 it rewrites rtd_career.rows only when a season is new.

rtd_career_sync.note: Run The Diamond's career (172). The page sends only seasons the server has not kept, once a visit; the row is written only when one is new.

cfb_fantasy_grant_pass.note: once, when a College Fantasy pass is bought

fantasy_grant_pass.note: once, when a Fantasy pass is bought

premium_recompute.note: on a purchase, a refund or a renewal

cfb_fantasy_swap.note: one write per swap the player makes

fantasy_swap.note: one write per swap the player makes

rtf_set_profile.note: hoops/auth.js sends only the fields that changed, when a player changes one

soccer_h2h_report.note: once per side per head to head match

soccer_h2h_submit_draft.note: once per side per head to head draft

stumpire_save_play.note: one write per move, each carrying a new version (functions/_stumpire/api.js), so the state always changes
